data.define: A casual word for good, or for agreeing.

misuse.text: Don't say 'cool' when someone shares sad news.
misuse.why: It sounds like you don't care.

native.tip: “cool” = 좋아; 괜찮아; 멋져. 예문: “Cool, see you at six!”
